product_metadata.title: Signature Design by Ashley Breegin New Traditional Wooden Chair Side End Table with 1 Drawer and 1 Fixed Shelf, Brown
features: ARTS AND CRAFTS FORM: End table is crafted from veneers, wood and manmade wood with a removable black PVC laminate tray.
CLASSIC DESIGN: Hand-applied finish with antiqued bronze-tone hardware
SPACE-EFFICIENT DESIGN: Chairside end table measures 13"W x 22"D x 23"H
ASSEMBLY REQUIRED: Easy-to-follow instructions, hardware and tools included
BUY WITH CONFIDENCE: Designed and manufactured by Ashley Furniture Industries. The trusted source for stylish furniture, lighting, rugs, accessories and mattresses. For every taste and budget
description: All the great elements of Mission-style design—including mortise-and-tenon decorative overlays—packed into an adorably sized chairside end table. Small but essential, this accent table includes a deep drawer with removable tray for handy storage. With a wide variety of styles and materials, accent tables can provide storage in a living room, give guests a spot to rest their drinks, and add subtle drama to your decor by presenting a place for artwork, a lamp or a plant. We have a wide selection of accent tables and occasional tables, from rustic farmhouse designs to modern openwork styles. They come in a variety of sizes, too, so you will find one that fits just where you need it.
